statistical_caveats: Only eight-action prefix is complete and fixed-length for all 12 episodes.
Only two failures; the 12 episodes are clustered across four different task families.
The reported label-reallocation fractions are unstratified descriptive references, not inferential p-values.
The 16- and 32-action windows are confounded by outcome-dependent episode termination.
Same hand-coded teacher generated all 12 role episodes; this is not an equally trained baseline.
No intervention or unselected counterfactual actions exist in the archived artifact.
decision: DO_NOT_OPTIMIZE_ACTION_ENTROPY. The clean fixed-horizon screen is weak (AUC 0.725). The more impressive later-window results are contaminated by episode length and termination. This does not support entropy as a causal mechanism or a native learning improvement.
